description: Standalone backtest twin of EXP-800 Safe Kelly 4/7/9 (live Tradier 6YA42569). Consumed by experiments/EXP-800-BT-safe-kelly/run.py. Top-level keys mirror configs/paper_exp800.yaml for sentinel G21 config parity.

fidelity_notes.kelly_state_machine: Ported verbatim from scripts/exp800_safe_kelly_scanner.py KellyStateDB.update_equity + _kelly_fraction: HWM never resets; tier transitions with -7% recovery hysteresis; tier-3 halt counter decrements one slot per scan day.
fidelity_notes.sizing_base: Live sizes off Alpaca portfolio_value (MTM equity). Engine flat sizing uses cash capital, so the runner scales max_risk_per_trade by equity/capital daily to size off MTM equity like live.
fidelity_notes.iron_condor_sizing: Live scanner sizes ICs on ONE wing using put-side credit only (contracts = equity*kelly% / ((width - put_credit)*100)) — an oversizing quirk vs the engine's two-wing max-loss convention. The runner rescales IC contracts to the live formula.
fidelity_notes.tier3_flatten: paper_exp800.yaml documents tier-3 as 'flatten open + halt 30 trades' but the deployed scanner only halts entries (no flatten code exists). Runner supports both: variant 'flatten' (as documented, EXP-3540 anti-thrash semantics: re-flatten only on a >=1pp new DD low, floor-sizing resume after halt) and 'haltonly' (as deployed).
fidelity_notes.momentum_filter: paper_exp800.yaml lists momentum_filter_pct: 2.0 but the deployed scanner never applies it; disabled here (fidelity to deployed code, not config aspiration).
fidelity_notes.vix_structure_signal: Live scanner proxies VIX term structure from a VIX 50d percentile (no live VIX3M feed); the backtest uses the canonical ComboRegimeDetector with real VIX/VIX3M ratio from data/historical_indices.sqlite (post-8f1bc8c loader). The registry describes EXP-800 regime as ComboRegimeDetector, which this matches.
fidelity_notes.vix_extreme_regime: Config maps VIX>=40 to NEUTRAL; ComboRegimeDetector maps it to bear. Moot for entries: vix_max_entry 40 blocks all entries on those days.
fidelity_notes.portfolio_risk_block: paper_exp800.yaml risk.portfolio_risk caps (60%/40%/4-per-expiration) are NOT enforced anywhere in the deployed scan path; the backtest keeps the engine's max_positions_per_expiration=4 key-stacking cap and no exposure cap (broker buying power approximated by max_positions=10).
fidelity_notes.expirations: Live picks the next Friday >= target DTE; engine uses nearest weekday expiration (Mon-Fri post-2022-09, MWF before) with Friday fallback.
